title: A tenant-scoped key asking for another tenant's rows is refused
rationale: The read path already does what the write path does not, and this case exists so that stays true. resolve_read_tenant refuses a foreign `tenant` query param with 403 before any data is fetched. Recording a satisfied guarantee in the same format as a defect is deliberate: it proves the fixture format expresses both, and it means a regression here fails as an ordinary red test rather than going unnoticed because no fixture covered the working path.

contract.note: Refused with "Not authorized to read another tenant's data" before the query runs.
